Witness the spirit of grandmastery behind Chivas Regal Crystalgold. Expect an evening of world-class mixology, grandmaster-level play and culinary artistry.

title: Charles Leclerc Interview
description: Chivas Regal invites select media for a 1:1 interview with Charles Leclerc, Global Brand Ambassador for Chivas Regal.

content.html:
Chivas Regal invites select media for a 1:1 interview with Charles Leclerc, Global Brand Ambassador for Chivas Regal.

As one of the most exciting talents in Formula 1, Charles brings his strategic mindset, tenacious spirit, and passion for pushing boundaries to his role with Chivas Regal. His partnership with the brand celebrates their shared ethos of collective success and celebrating every win – no matter how big or small.

This is a unique opportunity to hear first-hand from Charles on how his world of strategy, clarity, and creativity intersects with the craftsmanship of Chivas Regal’s latest innovation.

Dress Code: Playful & Elevated

title: Sandy Hyslop Interview
description: Chivas Regal invites select media for an exclusive 1:1 interview with Sandy Hyslop, Master Blender for Chivas Regal.

content.html:
Chivas Regal invites select media for an exclusive 1:1 interview with Sandy Hyslop, Master Blender for Chivas Regal.

With more than 40 years of experience in the Scotch whisky industry, Sandy is one of the most respected figures in whisky making. He will share insights into the craftsmanship, innovation, and heritage behind Chivas Regal Crystalgold, as well as his personal role in bringing this exceptional expression to life.

This is a unique opportunity to gain first-hand perspective from the creative mind behind the new innovation.

Dress Code: Playful & Elevated

title: The Regal Masterclass & Dining Experience
description: Michelin-starred Chef Vicky Cheng, celebrated for blending his Asian heritage with the artistry of French haute cuisine, brings his philosophy of elevated craftsmanship to AIR CCCC, Singapore’s pioneering circular campus where architecture, gardens, kitchens, and sustainability converge.

content.html:
Michelin-starred Chef Vicky Cheng, celebrated for blending his Asian heritage with the artistry of French haute cuisine, brings his philosophy of elevated craftsmanship to AIR CCCC, Singapore’s pioneering circular campus where architecture, gardens, kitchens, and sustainability converge.

Inspired by Chivas Regal’s spirit of innovation, the day begins with an intimate dumpling masterclass where Chef Vicky Cheng reimagines tradition through inventive flavours, complemented by a cocktail masterclass led by Rhys Wilson that highlights the versatility of Chivas Regal.

The experience culminates in an elegant multi-course dinner, paired with Chivas Regal and guided by Chef Cheng’s storytelling. A celebration of clarity and craft.

Dress Code: Playful & Elevated
